stem: Which sentence best describes the speaker's relationship with the river?

options.label: A
options.text: The river forces the speaker to make a decision.

options.label: B
options.text: The river reminds the speaker of what is important.

options.label: C
options.text: The river introduces the speaker to the outdoors.

options.label: D
options.text: The river provides the speaker with an unusual experience.
